mpc.controller_reference_timing_convention: pose-aligned next-row horizon at MPC_DT_S; WAYPOINT_DT_S is a declared upstream constant, not model waypoint timing
mpc.local_frame: +x forward, +y left, +z up; yaw radians CCW
mpc.tracker_instrumentation: subclass timestamps super()._solve; no objective, gain, limit, selection, or solve changes

source.scope: R00 and shared scene only; no other-source evaluation
source.coordinates: world metres yaw CCW; body forward/left; all local representations use original observation A

safety.query: full union direct GEOS, no B connector, no time/execution claim

rigid_fit.definition: closed-form minimum XY squared-error single left SE(2) transform; yaw assessed separately
